title: MathVis: Can AI Reason through Drawing? A Benchmark for Mathematical Figure Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.12954v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces MathVis, a benchmark designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to visualize frontier mathematical problems and perform diagram-assisted reasoning. The benchmark consists of 512 tasks, each comprising a mathematical statement, a reference diagram, executable TikZ or SVG code, a Gold Intermediate Representation (IR), atomic rubrics, and error codes. Through rigorous evaluation, GPT-6-Astra, Claude Fable 5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview achieve pass@1 scores of 31.25%, 26.56%, and 22.85%, respectively. We found that although the tasks require visualization, LLMs produce outputs dominated by formal languages, symbols, and graphics programs, rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning. Furthermore, while the solutions generated by LLMs may contain all the necessary elements, they are often visually confusing to humans. translated_title: MathVis：AI 能通过绘图进行推理吗？一个数学图形生成基准
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了 MathVis，一个旨在评估大语言模型（LLM）可视化前沿数学问题并执行图表辅助推理能力的基准。该基准包含 512 个任务，每个任务由一个数学命题、一张参考图、可执行的 TikZ 或 SVG 代码、一个黄金中间表示（Gold IR）、原子化评分标准以及错误代码构成。经过严格评估，GPT-6-Astra、Claude Fable 5 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview 的 pass@1 分数分别为 31.25%、26.56% 和 22.85%。研究发现，尽管这些任务需要可视化，LLM 生成的输出却以形式语言、符号和图形程序为主，而非显式的以图表为媒介的推理。此外，LLM 生成的解答虽然可能包含所有必要元素，但对人类而言在视觉上往往令人困惑。该基准旨在实现数学问题的可视化，并推动使 LLM 能够进行图形化推理的研究。
tldr: MathVis 基准通过 512 个数学图形生成任务评估了大语言模型的可视化与图表辅助推理能力，发现即使最先进的模型 pass@1 也仅约 31%，且其输出偏重形式语言和符号而非显式的图示推理，生成的图形对人类而言往往视觉混乱。
en_tdlr: MathVis is a 512-task benchmark for evaluating LLMs' mathematical figure generation and diagram-assisted reasoning, revealing that even frontier models achieve only ~31% pass@1 and rely on formal languages and symbols rather than explicit diagram-mediated reasoning, often producing visually confusing diagrams.
